reasoning_content: boards serve is running. It's a fresh build (build 43781 doesn't exist yet — no wait, that's the port, not a build). boards is the third app, and the build cache might be warm. Let's wait for this.

action.command:
for i in $(seq 1 9); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:43781/ 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "boards UP at check $i"; break; }
  sleep 50
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "boards: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:43781/ 2>/dev/null; free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print "available="$6"MB"}'

tool_call.name: terminal
